entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.96 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC &
Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Katka, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report stating that daughter of the informant Pradumn @ Padum Nishad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91276604/
1 aged about 17 years had left home on 09.05.2024 and was enticed by the applicant.

entities.text: Pradumn @ Padum Nishad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had earlier gone to Ambedkar Nagar and thereafter to Delhi where wrong was committed on her.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she had gone and stayed at the home of the applicant for two days and thereafter she went to Delhi.
Allegations of physical relations were also levelled.
The tentative age of the victim is 16 to 17 years.
The medical does not corroborate any of the allegations.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the FIR itself was lodged after a substantial delay and the statements under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. demonstrates that the applicant and the victim stayed together at various places, the applicant who is in custody since 22.05.2024 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pradumn @ Padum Nishad be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
